Mali.title: Mali: after the takeover of Kidal, the FAMa launch a new operation
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by the Russian Africa Corps, are conducting a sweep operation in southern Kidal, after the city was retaken on October 6. According to the Africa Corps, armed combatants fled in a hurry as troops approached. Indeed, on October 6, the army entered the city of Kidal around 1 p.m., according to Malian security sources .

Mali.title: Me Mountaga Tall: we don't talk about it anymore?
Mali.summary: Five months after his alleged abduction, the silence around the fate of Me Mountaga Tall seems to settle. A situation that worries relatives, relatives and even human rights organizations. The name of Me Mountaga Tall, once very present in the debate and on social networks, seems to be gradually disappearing from the news.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Allied Mali-Russian forces thwart terrorist ambushes on the outskirts of Kidal
Mali.summary: During their advance on Kidal, the joint units of Mali and Russia neutralized several ambush threats during reconnaissance patrols on the outskirts of the city. Several ambush locations were thus identified by the reconnaissance teams . According to the information gathered, the mission assigned to these terrorist groups was to delay the advance of the allied forces while the main forces of the terrorist coalition formed by the Fla (Frame for the Liberation of Azawad) and the JNIM (Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims) withdrew from Kidal.

Mali.title: Mali: A return in trompe-l'oeil of the Fama in Kidal?
Mali.summary: The Malian army and its Africa Corps allies announced that they had reinvested Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The Fla (Azawad Liberation Front) and the Jnim (Support Group for Islam and Muslims) claim a tactical withdrawal to preserve the populations. Some think that this return bears the mark of Algiers.

Mali.title: Kéniéba: An international network for money laundering and trafficking in cultural property dismantled
Mali.summary: The Keniéba Gendarmerie Brigade recently arrested a young man from Faléa, Kéniéba commune, Kayes region, involved in an alleged international network of money laundering and trafficking in cultural property. The operation led to the seizure of 3 carved doors of great heritage value, which were allegedly stolen from Dékon, in the Bandiagara region, and intended for export to the West Source: L’Indicateur du Renouveau, Mali

Mali.title: Military justice: Bamako Court sentences military and civilians for arms trafficking
Mali.summary: Military justice: The Court of Bamako convicts military and civilians for arms trafficking The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, its ordinary correctional hearing, presided over by Magistrate Assama Dolo. Five cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for serious acts related to weapons and military discipline .

Mali.title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
Mali.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory -- it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

Mali.title: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maiga and his men at the heart of the FAMa's takeover and securing of the city
Mali.summary: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maïga, from the "red beret" to the command of the FAMa to consolidate the presence of the Malian State The truth of the weapons and the terrain prevailed over the opposing propaganda: Kidal is definitively and fully released, secured and reinstated in the bosom of the Republic of Mali . Colonel Attaher Maiga In the aftermath of this decisive step taken by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), it is a poignant testimony, full of assurance, authority and patriotism, delivered by Colonel Attaher A.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa intensify their air-land operations in the Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit sectors
Mali.summary: Bamako, 7 October 2026 – The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely continuing their missions to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the information provided by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, several aero-terrestrial actions were carried out on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 in different sectors of the Eastern Theater, in particular in the Talhandak areas, north of Kidal and in the Tessalit region .

Mali.title: Militant spillover from Mali raises mining-related security risks in Guinea
Mali.summary: Executive summary Guinea has remained largely insulated from the militant violence affecting neighboring Mali. However, the security environment along the Mali-Guinea border has become increasingly fragile as the al-Qaeda-affiliated Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) has expanded and entrenched its presence across southern Mali. This expansion has brought militant activity closer to Guinea’s eastern border areas, where major industrial and artisanal mining sites are located.

Niger.title: PANDEF mourns victims of Ondo Air Force crash, seeks probe
Niger.summary: By Henry Umoru ABUJA — The Pan Niger Delta Forum (PANDEF), the apex socio-political body of the South-South geopolitical zone, has mourned the victims of the Nigerian Air Force (NAF) aircraft crash in the Igbokoda area of Ilaje Local Government Area of Ondo State. PANDEF also called for a thorough and comprehensive investigation to determine the circumstances that may have contributed to the crash and similar aviation tragedies.

Niger.title: The Nigerien Armed Forces sensitized on the general mobilization
Niger.summary: Niamey, 08 Oct(ANP)- The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani KIAOU chaired, on Wednesday, October 07, 2026 at the Palais des Congrès in Niamey, an exchange meeting with the Commission responsible for the organization, preparation and monitoring of the implementation of the General Mobilization (COMOG) .
